verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never names a transcription model or engine, makes no accuracy claims, and documents no known limits such as accents, crosstalk or noise. The nearest material is language coverage (31 desktop and 17 mobile languages), speaker-tag labelling and capture via computer audio. Those describe feature scope rather than how transcription works or how good it is, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a product manager, the vendor documents how transcription actually works and its quality (models, accuracy claims, known limits) rather than just saying "AI-powered"
